title: I Saw An Old Friend In Burma
blurb:
The ferry from Rangoon to Port Blair carries soldiers, prisoners, and old friends.

When the newly appointed governor of a remote island prison encounters an old friend who doesn't seem to recognise him, he finds the man has changed beyond all recognition in the twenty years since the war.

By the time land appears on the horizon, the man who boarded the ferry is no more, and in his place stands someone who has only just begun to look at the world through new eyes.
